metadata.title: Strata

home.title: Strata

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: For yourself, your team or your company.
signUp.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to finish creating your account.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: We'll email you a link to choose a new one.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way.

fields.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a digit.

onboarding.title: Create a workspace
onboarding.subtitle: Choose how you'll use Strata. You can switch features on or off later.

personal.name: Personal
personal.description: Your own calendar and time off.

team.name: Team
team.description: A manager and their team: people, calendar and time off.

company.name: Company
company.description: A whole organization: people, structure, time off, capacity and cost planning.

dashboard.title: Home
dashboard.comingBody: People, calendar and planning arrive here as they're built. Start by inviting your team in Settings.

invitation.subject: {inviter} invited you to {workspace} on Strata
invitation.heading: Join {workspace} on Strata
invitation.footer: This invitation expires in 7 days. If you weren't expecting it, you can ignore this email.

invite.title: You're invited
invite.wrongAccount: You're signed in as {current}. This invitation is for {email}: sign out and sign in with that address.

status.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
status.accepted: This invitation has already been used.

settings.title: Settings
settings.chooseBody: Pick a settings section from the list.
settings.largerScreenBody: Workspace settings need more room. Open Strata on a tablet or computer to make changes here.

general.title: General
general.addressHint: Changing the address breaks old links to this workspace.

features.title: Features
features.intro: Switch on what this workspace uses. Turning a feature off hides it; its data is kept.
features.confirmBody: These features depend on it and will be turned off too: {features}.

people.name: People
people.description: Directory, profiles, hierarchy, positions, custom fields and import.

time.name: Calendar and time off
time.description: Calendar, time types, leave, allowances and approvals.

rate_cards.name: Rate cards
rate_cards.description: Cost rules applied to people and planned roles.

members.title: Members
members.rolesDialogBody: Each role adds permissions. Owners have every permission anyway.
members.deactivateBody: They lose access straight away. Their history stays, and you can reactivate them later.

inviteDialog.title: Invite people
inviteDialog.emailsHint: Separate addresses with commas or new lines.
inviteDialog.sent: {count, plural, one {Invitation sent} other {# invitations sent}}

view.name: View members
view.description: See who is in the workspace.

invite.name: Invite members
invite.description: Invite people by email and manage pending invitations.

view.name: View org chart
view.description: See the reporting chart and hierarchy.

edit.name: Edit people
edit.description: Change people's details, team, manager and position.

import.name: Import people
import.description: Upload people files and apply the changes.

manage_structure.name: Manage structure
manage_structure.description: Edit hierarchy, positions, career levels, employment types and custom fields.

manage_settings.name: Manage planning settings
manage_settings.description: Planning period, horizon, units and rules.

apply.name: Apply rate cards
apply.description: Apply rate cards to a scenario.

manage.name: Manage roles
manage.description: Create, edit, duplicate and archive roles.

assign.name: Assign roles
assign.description: Give roles to members and take them away.

book_for_others.name: Book for others
book_for_others.description: Book time on someone else's behalf.

manage_settings.name: Manage time settings
manage_settings.description: Edit time types, allowance policies, work schedules and holiday calendars.

manage_settings.name: Manage workspace settings
manage_settings.description: Change name, address, region settings, currency and fiscal year.

view_audit.name: View audit log
view_audit.description: See who changed access and settings, and when.

roles.title: Roles
roles.intro: A role is a set of permissions. Give people several roles; their permissions add up.
roles.adminNotice: The Admin role has every permission across the workspace and can't be changed.
roles.readOnly: You can see this role but not change it.
roles.nameTaken: A role with that name already exists.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Changes to access and settings. Entries can't be edited or deleted.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: You always see notifications in Strata. Choose which ones also come by email.
notifications.emailNotice: Emails start once Strata's email sending is set up.

role.removed: The {role} role was removed from you

ownership.received: You're now an owner of this workspace
